top3.title: Dirty Old Power Tour | AJJ
top3.why: AJJ (formerly Andrew Jackson Jihad) bring their scrappy, politically sharp folk-punk to Philly on the Dirty Old Power tour, with Greet Death opening. It's an all-ages R5 Productions show at First Unitarian — Philly's home base for exactly this kind of DIY, community-minded bill. Doors at 7:30, show at 8; tickets run about $33.

top3.title: Palestine Cinema Days 2026: Foragers
top3.why: Palestine Cinema Days' touring program brings the documentary "Foragers" to Vox Populi — a rare chance to see Palestinian and Palestine-focused nonfiction film on a big screen here, outside the festival circuit. Vox Populi is an artist-run cooperative gallery, a few blocks from the Convention Center and the Market-Frankford Line's 11th Street stop.

top3.title: Philadelphia Psychotronic Film Society
top3.why: PhilaMOCA's long-running Psychotronic Film Society pulls another deep-cut genre oddity out of the vault — cheap ($5 at the door), weird, and exactly what this venue exists for. Doors at 7, screening at 7:30; the series doesn't always name the film in advance, which is part of the appeal.
